header: Arguments for and against, in two facing columns
lead: One list of rows, sorted into the two columns by each row's own toggle — so moving an argument from one side to the other is a switch, not a cut and paste.

points.title: A row with its toggle on lands in the column for.
The optional value beside it can hold a weighting, an option name or a source.
A row with its toggle off lands in the column against.
The markers are a plus and a minus, so the two sides stay distinguishable in print and without colour.
